testCase:
G-035: Download a statement, check it, upload proof of address
Goal: Download the Kestrelmoor March statement, check that it lists Fernhollow Grocers, and upload a bill as proof of address.
STEP 1: Navigate to /gopro/patterns/p35.html
STEP 2: Click the "Statement as CSV" link
STEP 3: Verify that "kestrelmoor-march.csv" was downloaded
STEP 4: Verify that row 2 of the downloaded file "kestrelmoor-march.csv" contains "Fernhollow Grocers"
STEP 5: Upload "patterns/p35-bill.txt" to the "Proof of address" field
STEP 6: Verify "Received: p35-bill.txt" is visible
STEP 7: Verify that 'Document under review' is visible

steps.note: Open the statement and proof-of-address page.
Verify the downloaded filename and merchant text, but not its row position.
Upload the specified bill from the site.
Verify receipt of the uploaded bill.

reasoning: This plan checks the statement download, its merchant text, and the proof-of-address upload confirmation. The catalog can inspect CSV contents but cannot verify text specifically in row 2, so that requirement is only partially covered.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that Fernhollow Grocers occurs specifically in row 2 of kestrelmoor-march.csv; the catalog has no row-specific CSV content assertion.
gaps: Verify that Fernhollow Grocers occurs specifically in row 2 of kestrelmoor-march.csv; the catalog has no row-specific CSV content assertion.
